name: ASLAN
description:
Dorotape are the only UK Gold Distributor for ASLAN vinyl and films for signmaking, digital printing and stencil masking.

We work closely with ASLAN to bring you the very best in metallised, dichroic and glassline finishes as well as other speciality films such as their wide range of memoboard films.

For more than 70 years, ASLAN have successfully developed and manufactured an extensive product range including self-adhesive films for signmaking and large format digital printing & lamination.

Their slogan of 'Where quality meets specialities' embodies the fact that they also produce niche products for many other sectors such as paint masking and sandblast stenciling, architectural and interior design, corporate branding as well as commercial, educational and healthcare organisation.

Based just outside Cologne, the ASLAN team ensure that they offer the best products to the market, which are available in over 80 countires worldwide.

The partnership between ASLAN & Dorotape means that the full range of these products with the quality assurance of being "Made in Germany" are available from stock ready for next day nationwide delivery.
